scope: local RV64 dual-issue OoO full-core functional evidence

run_directory.path_identity: producer output directories and durable artifacts are checked lexically; any symlink component, including a final file alias, is rejected before hashing or creation

configuration_control.npc_config: current .config is an immutable input and must enable CONFIG_NPC_DIFFTEST=y
configuration_control.nemu_config: current .config is an immutable riscv64 interpreter/system reference input
configuration_control.input_binding: hash before execution and after the final cohort
configuration_control.design_binding: same live RTL design_id for module and functional stages

status_contract.pass_authority: explicit module, functional and semantic-verifier PASS markers plus evidence_complete after result verification
status_contract.marker_cardinality: module, functional, semantic-verifier and optional publication logs each contain exactly one stage PASS marker and no same-stage FAIL marker

semantic_revalidation.source_run: exact same-run result/status/module/input/artifact/retention field sets and canonical run-local paths
semantic_revalidation.official_membership: exact 177 test ids derived from the live regression suite arrays and their local .S source stems
semantic_revalidation.terminal_log: exact regeneration including F0-G1 PASS, ppa=UNQUALIFIED and promotion_eligible=false
semantic_revalidation.mutations: exact canonical 14-case inventory: 11 schema-valid rejections and 3 schema-invalid rejections, followed by read-only replay from retained mutation inputs
semantic_revalidation.suite_guest_logs: every same-run official/AM wrapper is reopened; its unique source-log section must contain exactly one architectural PASS terminal and AM must contain exactly one DiffTest-ON state with no OFF state
semantic_revalidation.raw_log_provenance: simulator-build, official, AM and benchmark wrappers bind an exact same-run raw-log path and SHA-256; consumers parse the wrapper delimiters as bytes, reopen the retained raw log and require byte equality before UTF-8 semantic parsing
semantic_revalidation.benchmarks: CoreMark iterations/CRC/PASS and Dhrystone run-count/PASS are parsed exactly once from guest output; duplicate or conflicting metric lines are rejected and never inferred from command arguments
semantic_revalidation.module_binding: same-run module result, complete PASS status, exact required-test inventory, symlink-free run-local status/log/input paths and exact nonempty RTL/header/filelist/test/workflow input groups
semantic_revalidation.live_binding: frozen pre/post inputs equal each other and, for current publication, equal recaptured live inputs

publication.precondition: durable local result is semantically revalidated against frozen inputs and full-core-current.status is exactly PASS
publication.status: a separate fail-closed full-core-publication.status; canonical consumers require PASS
publication.commit_marker_order: last among canonical evidence files, followed only by publication-status finalization
publication.canonical_path_identity: canonical destination and .tmp-full-core-current path components are checked lexically before open; parent, final and dangling symlinks are rejected, and temporary creation is exclusive/no-follow
publication.interrupted_publication: old or absent binding mismatches the data files and is rejected
publication.downstream_f0_consumer: requires exact binding schema/cohort/design, immutable same-run source result and module closure, live official/AM source membership, execution PASS, publication PASS, source/canonical hash equality, read-only replay of the exact 14-case mutations, guest benchmark line parsing and byte-exact terminal receipt

build_isolation.temporary_roots: NEMU reference, AM/klib archives, cpu-test image, CoreMark image and Dhrystone image
build_isolation.source_tree_observation: known configuration is fingerprinted pre/post; AM/benchmark .result, Makefile.*, build and obj_dir secondary products must be absent both before and after the smoke
build_isolation.smoke_success: reference=1, AM image/archive=1, klib archive=1, benchmark_images=2, source_tree_drift=0 and retained_temp_products=0

reuse_and_rerun.checker_only_change: versioned replay is allowed when frozen inputs, terminal evidence and hashes are complete

review.gate_routing: the C pointer maps the runner, all three functional schemas, architecture identity helper, official inventory runner, AM result checker and relevant build entrypoints to rv64-full-core-runner-contract

non_claims: This policy does not by itself establish ARCH_STABLE.
This policy does not qualify synthesis, STA, power, area, CPI or PPA.
This policy adopts sign-off-grade configuration and evidence discipline; it does not claim equivalence to any proprietary vendor flow.
